summary: Add shared native formal owner confirmation with scoped single-use proof and demo-only payment integration.
reason: Owner requests reusable title/text/action confirmation for all capabilities, with payment kept as a distinct guarded consumer.

tests.name: generalized-contract-tests
tests.evidence: TypeScript compile passed; 21 generic confirmation and 36 payment core cases, API/registry and conversation/sharing/Remote Bridge regressions passed. Generic proof scope, replay, expiry, forged approval and concurrency verified offline.

capabilities.reason: Canonical capability and activation limits are owned by ui-playbooks; implementation repositories do not duplicate its registry.

architecture.reason: Extend existing Companion registry and existing Android app; no new database, daemon, scheduler or execution owner.

rollback: Restore scoped previous APK/runtime, retain payment guard records and do not replay any request.
limitations: Only inert demo adapter enabled; real providers blocked before network.
Bank challenge handling, real success receipt and background notification fallback remain unimplemented.
Hardware confirmation acceptance and installation are separate from source tests.
Private S24 development build; no broad device or cross-channel availability claim.
Only integrated consumers enforce confirmation; no absolute isolation against local owner-level file or code modification.
